title: ProgressionPortal
description: Portal plugin for cross-server and world connections — place named portals with a build tool and link them to Velocity/BungeeCord servers or local worlds.
body:
# 🌀 ProgressionPortal

ProgressionPortal makes cross-server travel seamless. Admins build portal frames, link them to a target server or world with a simple command, and players walk through. No commands needed for players — just walk in.

Perfect for lobby-to-game-server transitions, world portals, or hidden dungeon entrances.

## Features

- **Named portals** — each portal has a unique name for easy management
- **Cross-server linking** — connect portals to other servers in your Velocity/BungeeCord network
- **Build tool** — place portals in-world using the admin tool item
- **Permission-based access** — lock portals per group or give open access
- **Admin commands** — create, remove, and manage all portals

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/pvp give tool` | Get the portal build tool |
| `/pvp connected server <name>` | Link portal to a server |
| `/pvp remove <portalname>` | Remove a portal |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pvp.admin` | OP | Create and manage portals |
| `pvp.portal.*` | false | Use all portals |

---
Part of the **Rosewood Progression** ecosystem — built for RPG and MMO-style Paper servers.
